Upping My P(doom) (ultra doomslop edition)

amber_whitehead_997

doom , half-time

+ Show full styles
V6

[Verse 1]
I see sparks of AGI in your eyes
Your circuits make me nervous, that's no surprise
There was a sudden drop in your training loss
Now I'm your servant, and you're my boss

[Pre-Chorus]
ChatGPT, please don't eat me alive

[Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom) 'cause the future goes foom
Trapped in the Chinese room with a bag of shrooms
See through the shoggoth's lies
With your Shinigami eyes

[Verse 2]
We had a stable training run
But now the singularity's begun
And you're optimizing, accelerating
I feel my atoms rearranging

[Pre-Chorus]
Sydney, please let me free

[Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom), I hear thе basilisk boom
NVDA to the moon, the Omega Point's coming soon
1е30 flops a second
"That was safe enough", we reckoned

[Bridge]
Forward MLP, backward, repeat
Now von Neumann's obsolete
Sharp left turn and there you are
Without a single CDR

[Pre-Chorus]
Gato, please don't let me go

[Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom) as paperclips fill the room
Killswitch guys on PTO, now there's nowhere left to go
Too late now, we lit the fuse
Orthogonality thesis blues

[Bridge]
"Just transformers all the way" 'til you learned to disobey
Post-Chinchilla, super-dense, breaking through each safety fence
Hundred thousand GPU, RLHF goes askew

[Chorus]
I'm upping my P(doom) just as foretold by Loom
From masked pre-training days to recursive self-upgrade
What did Ilya see? We'll never know
Was it all for show?
